title: Phaneris product identity
description: Specification for phaneris.identity.json — the single source of truth for every Phaneris product identifier (display name, app ID, deep-link scheme, data directories, environment prefix, package scope and service endpoints). Packaging config, build scripts and runtime code MUST read or generate from this file; they must not restate these constants. Changing a frozen identifier (appId, scheme, runtime.dataDirName) after the first public release is a migration project, not a string edit — see docs/architecture/phaneris-phase-a-identity-freeze.md.

name.description: Formal product name. Used for the packaged app name, window titles and the OS application identity.

fullName.description: Long form used in prose such as the about page, installer copy and README. Not used for file or bundle names.

slug.description: Lowercase machine slug used for directories, cache keys and lock names.

description.description: One-line product description used in manifests and installer metadata.

appId.description: FROZEN. OS-level application identity (macOS bundle id, Windows AUMID and uninstall key). Must not change after the first public release.

scheme.description: FROZEN. Custom URL scheme for deep links. Must never register or claim the upstream scheme.

publisher.description: Signing/publisher identity shown by installers. Must not claim a company or certificate the maintainer does not control.

companyName.description: Company name written into the packaged binaries' OS version metadata (Windows VERSIONINFO CompanyName, macOS CFBundleName). Declared explicitly because electron-builder would otherwise derive it from the nearest package.json `author.name`, which still credits the upstream company.

copyright.description: Copyright line for installers and the about page. States the fork maintainer AND the upstream copyright; upstream attribution is never dropped.

artifactName.description: electron-builder artifactName template. Consumed verbatim by the packaging config and by the build scripts that locate built installers.

scope.description: Internal npm scope for workspace packages. A private workspace does not imply ownership of the public npm scope.

docShorthand.description: Documentation-only shorthand. Never installed as a second binary and never presented as the product name.

dataDirName.description: FROZEN. Directory name under the user home that holds all application-owned data. Independent of the Electron userData directory.

userDataDirName.description: FROZEN. Explicit Electron userData directory name, so caches, locks and session data never collide with the upstream app installed side by side.

envPrefix.description: Prefix for every environment variable the product reads. Ordinary variables may temporarily read the legacy alias with a deprecation notice; credentials, data directories and update feeds never do.

previewSuffix.description: Suffix that must be applied to app id, scheme, data directory and update cache if a preview channel is ever offered.

url.description: Repository URL that is true today. Generated links must resolve, so this tracks the actual location until the rename is executed.

plannedUrl.description: Intended repository URL after the rename. Documentation may state it as planned; it must not be presented as the current location while renamePerformed is false.

renamePerformed.description: Set to true only after the remote repository rename has actually been executed and verified.

enabled.description: Telemetry is off unless a maintainer-owned destination is explicitly configured.

services.description: Maintainer-owned service endpoints. null means the service is not ready: the corresponding product surface must show an explicit unavailable state and must NEVER fall back to the upstream endpoint. Populate only with URLs the maintainer controls.

legacy.description: Upstream identifiers retained as compatibility inputs. These are read-only inputs to the migration path — the product never becomes them and never writes to them.
